description: The District of Columbia Courts, on behalf of the Office of the General Counsel, seeks a qualified vendor to provide a cloud-hosted, configurable commercial-off-the-shelf (“COTS”) Legal Case and Document Management System, including necessary software, licenses, warranties, and related services to include installation, document migration, implementation, on-site post-implementation support and training, and maintenance and support as specified in Section C (Description/Specifications/Work Statement).
